## CookieExpiryInfo.storedAt property

The date used as "now" when the cookie was stored in a [CookieJar](./tough-cookie.cookiejar.md) (ISO-8601 UTC). This is [SetCookieOptions.now](./tough-cookie.setcookieoptions.now.md) when that option is used (e.g. to pass the server response's `Date` header), otherwise it is the local clock. `null` if the cookie was never stored with recording enabled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
storedAt: string | null;
```
